parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against target CHEMBL203. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter where target_dictionary.chembl_id is CHEMBL203 and assays.assay_organism is Homo sapiens. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
